//: Colours are lifted from src/index.css (the "Album" look, light theme) and the icon (assets/icon.svg), so the marketing set cannot drift from the app.
//font: The app's own typefaces, loaded from the app's bundled files (assets/fonts/fonts.css points at src/assets/fonts/): `display` sets the headline and the ribbon, `text` the subline and the points.
//backgrounds: Presets referenced by slide.background: one flat colour and what stands on it. fill = the canvas; ink = the headline; inkSoft = the subline; shade = the colour every shadow is mixed from (a darker tone of the fill, never grey); chip / chipInk / tick = a point's pill, its text and its tick; ribbon / ribbonInk = the corner ribbon (unused: Bildklar has an in-app purchase). teal is the icon's own colour (--t-accent-fill) with white on it — the set's colour; paper the app's page (a shade darker, so the white phone screen stands off it) with the app's ink; night the app's dark page, for the screen shown in dark mode.
//device: The frame is drawn in CSS, not composited from a PNG (assets/frames/README.md); its proportions are in templates/slide.css. bezel is its colour: near the app's night page, a cool black rather than a grey one.
